part.text:
Implemented the fix in `tokio/src/fs/file.rs:594`: `poll_read` now returns `Poll::Ready(Ok(()))` immediately when the destination buffer has zero remaining capacity, avoiding the stale zero-byte background read and subsequent false EOF.

Validated with the full `fs_file` test suite: 17 passed, including `empty_read`.
